generation.shared_art_direction: Premium photorealistic editorial documentary photography for a global energy technology company. Wide 16:9 compositions; cool cobalt, blue, and steel neutrals; selective warm safety accents; credible experts, equipment, and operating environments; natural or restrained cinematic light; no logos, watermarks, readable text, staged handshakes, disaster imagery, or distorted anatomy.

assets.alt_en: Field ecologists record biodiversity observations in native wetland habitat near an operating site.
assets.alt_es_mx: Ecólogos de campo registran observaciones de biodiversidad en un humedal nativo cerca de un sitio operativo.
assets.prompt_brief: Two field ecologists conducting a habitat transect in a biodiverse wetland and native grassland, with discreet energy infrastructure in the distance.

assets.alt_en: Environmental specialists collect a clear-water sample at an industrial water reuse facility.
assets.alt_es_mx: Especialistas ambientales toman una muestra de agua limpia en una instalación industrial de reutilización de agua.
assets.prompt_brief: Environmental specialists collecting and checking a clear-water sample at a modern treatment and reuse operation.

assets.alt_en: A technician inspects an industrial component in a circular equipment refurbishment center.
assets.alt_es_mx: Un técnico inspecciona un componente industrial en un centro de reacondicionamiento circular de equipos.
assets.prompt_brief: Technician inspecting a reusable circular industrial component in a clean refurbishment center, with a subtle loop motif in the workspace.

assets.placement: Nature and responsible operations - Start with place
assets.alt_en: A multidisciplinary team reviews local watershed and land conditions above an operating site.

assets.prompt_brief: Team using a map and tablet at an overlook to understand a semi-arid watershed, terrain, and distant facility in context.

assets.alt_en: An aerial methane survey is underway above an industrial processing facility.
assets.alt_es_mx: Se realiza un levantamiento aéreo de metano sobre una instalación de procesamiento industrial.
assets.prompt_brief: High-oblique aerial survey with a sensor drone in the foreground and a large processing facility grid below.

assets.alt_en: A technician calibrates a methane sensor beside production equipment.
assets.alt_es_mx: Un técnico calibra un sensor de metano junto a equipos de producción.
assets.prompt_brief: Close environmental detail of a field technician using a handheld methane instrument at a wellhead.

assets.alt_en: Two engineers compare emissions-reduction options beside process equipment.
assets.alt_es_mx: Dos ingenieros comparan opciones para reducir emisiones junto a equipos de proceso.
assets.prompt_brief: Two engineers with a tablet inspecting compressor equipment and prioritizing intervention choices.

assets.alt_en: Technicians perform a planned emissions-reduction intervention on a compressor.
assets.alt_es_mx: Técnicos realizan una intervención planificada para reducir emisiones en un compresor.
assets.prompt_brief: Two technicians carrying out precise planned maintenance on an industrial compressor.

assets.alt_en: An engineer compares verified emissions data with current facility performance.
assets.alt_es_mx: Un ingeniero compara datos verificados de emisiones con el desempeño actual de la instalación.
assets.prompt_brief: Emissions engineer in a glass-walled operations room verifying abstract performance trends against the live facility.

assets.alt_en: An operations team conducts a field briefing before decarbonization work begins.
assets.alt_es_mx: Un equipo de operaciones realiza una sesión de campo antes de iniciar trabajos de descarbonización.
